name: media_grid
title: Media Grid
description: Grid of 1-4 media cells in the social post layout (1 = full width, 2 = side by side, 3 = one wide + two, 4 = 2 x 2): images open in the popup gallery, videos play in place. More items than "max": the last cell shows "+N" and the rest is in the popup gallery. Used by social_post_listing and the block_highlight case study layout.
